scripts.dev: pnpm run agent & pnpm run dev:server & pnpm run dev:web & wait
scripts.dev:server: bash rust/scripts/cargo-shim.sh watch --workdir rust -w src -x 'run --features asr-align -- --no-browser --port 8018'
scripts.agent: test -x rust/target/debug/sentence-video && rust/target/debug/sentence-video agent --port 4000 || bash rust/scripts/cargo-shim.sh run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -- agent --port 4000
scripts.build: pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:web
